failure_modes.name: Double-Spend in CBDC Ledger
failure_modes.description: Customer can spend the same CBDC token twice due to missing idempotency checks or race conditions in ledger commit. Results in negative merchant balance or unreconciled entries.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order 1 and Order 2 initiated simultaneously by same customer; both commit with same balance without mutual exclusion.
root_cause_patterns: missing ledger transaction lock
concurrent payment confirmation
no idempotency key validation
failure_modes.system_impact: Ledger balance corruption, merchant settlement incorrect, regulatory breach
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via reconciliation.IsReconciled() returning false; trigger manual ledger reversal and customer re-payment
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement ledger transaction locks, idempotency key validation, pre-commit balance verification

failure_modes.name: Settlement Batch Mismatch
failure_modes.description: Settlement consolidation includes wrong merchants or amounts, causing batch total to differ from sum of orders. Ledger records batch but individual order lineage shows different amounts.
failure_modes.example_scenario: ConsolidateSettlementBatch() groups 3 orders (100, 200, 300 paise) but ledger records 500 paise total.
root_cause_patterns: incorrect merchant grouping logic
amount rounding error in batch sum
orders added/removed during consolidation window
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant reconciliation fails, settlement history audit breaks, financial discrepancy
failure_modes.recovery_path: Reconciliation check VerifyOrderSettlement() should catch; halt settlement, re-validate batch composition
failure_modes.prevention_control: Validate batch sum against individual orders pre-commit, use deterministic sorting for merchant grouping

failure_modes.name: Netting Calculation Overflow
failure_modes.description: Multi-merchant netting calculation overflows or underflows integer bounds, causing negative merchant positions or settlement amount truncation.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Three merchants settle with large bilateral transfers; netting sum exceeds int64 max, stored as negative value
root_cause_patterns: no overflow check in netting sum
unsigned/signed integer mismatch
accumulator not big.Int
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant settlements incorrect, accounting ledger imbalance, regulatory reporting wrong
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect in ConvertToCBDCPositions() via range check; fall back to serial settlement (no netting)
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use big.Int for netting accumulators, validate sum before final commit, test with large amounts

failure_modes.name: Settlement Finality Violation
failure_modes.description: Order marked as settled but ledger transaction not yet committed (t+1 latency not respected). Subsequent queries show conflicting settlement status.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order workflow transitions to Fulfilled before CBDC ledger WaitSettlementCompletion() returns success
root_cause_patterns: order status updated before ledger confirmation
async ledger commit without blocking
no settlement finality verification
failure_modes.system_impact: Order lineage shows settled but ledger shows pending; reconciliation detects contradiction
failure_modes.recovery_path: Lineage tracker detects mismatch via VerifyOrderSettlement(); rollback order to StatusPaid state
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce blocking ledger.CommitTransaction() before updating order status to Fulfilled

failure_modes.name: Orphaned Settlement Records
failure_modes.description: Settlement record created in ledger but order workflow does not complete (e.g., network partition). Merchant payment stuck in limbo, customer not charged.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement initiated, ledger.CommitTransaction() succeeds, but workflow crashes before lineage.Record() called
root_cause_patterns: settlement committed but workflow not updated
no compensating transaction on partial failure
missing settlement acknowledgment handshake
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant balance increased but order not marked fulfilled; settlement-order mismatch in reconciliation
failure_modes.recovery_path: Reconciliation query finds settlement without matching order; create manual order correction entry
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use two-phase commit pattern: prepare settlement, record in lineage, then finalize order status

failure_modes.name: Currency Conversion Error in Settlement
failure_modes.description: FX conversion applied with stale rate or rounding error, causing merchant to receive different amount than order value in foreign currency settlement.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order in EUR settled to INR merchant; FX rate outdated by >5min or rounding loses paise
root_cause_patterns: FX rate cache not invalidated
rounding to nearest rupee instead of paise
no FX rate validation before conversion
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant receives incorrect amount, customer complaint, potential regulatory fine
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via lineage tracking FX rate metadata; calculate adjustment, issue credit note
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce FX rate freshness check (max 1min old), use bankers rounding to paise, audit trail FX rates used

failure_modes.name: Batch Settlement Timeout
failure_modes.description: Settlement batch initiated but CBDC ledger does not respond within SLA, leaving orders in inconsistent state (settlement initiated but not confirmed).
failure_modes.example_scenario: ConsolidateSettlementBatch() times out at t+30min; orders remain StatusPending, customer refund timeout triggers
root_cause_patterns: CBDC ledger unavailable
long network latency
batch processing queue overloaded
no settlement timeout retry logic
failure_modes.system_impact: Orders stuck in settlement limbo, merchants not paid, customers refunded late, SLA breach
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitor settlement timeout; trigger escalation to settlement agent to retry with exponential backoff
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement settlement timeout SLA (e.g., 5min), automatic retry with circuit breaker, HITL escalation after 3 retries

failure_modes.name: Reconciliation Data Loss
failure_modes.description: Settlement record lost or corrupted in storage (database, cache, ledger snapshot), causing reconciliation to report missing entries and imbalance.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Ledger snapshot taken but settlement batch record not included due to timing issue; reconciliation.IsReconciled() returns false
root_cause_patterns: database transaction rolled back unexpectedly
ledger snapshot race condition
cache eviction without persistent backup
failure_modes.system_impact: Cannot prove settlement occurred, audit trail broken, regulatory inspection failure
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via reconciliation mismatch; query backup ledger, restore from transaction log replay
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement dual-write to persistent ledger and backup store, transaction log replication, periodic audit snapshots

failure_modes.name: AML Velocity Breach (Undetected)
failure_modes.description: Customer makes rapid transactions exceeding velocity limits (e.g., 5 orders >₹50k in 1 hour) but compliance check is bypassed or returns false negative. Order settles without AML block.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer submits 5 orders of ₹51k each in 45 minutes; velocity checker cached outdated results, orders approved
root_cause_patterns: velocity cache not invalidated on order creation
timestamp comparison off-by-one in window calculation
concurrent order submission race condition
failure_modes.system_impact: Potential money laundering proceeds through system, regulatory breach, customer sanction evasion
failure_modes.recovery_path: Post-settlement compliance audit detects pattern; flag orders for HITL review, reverse settlements, file regulatory report
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce real-time velocity check before payment initiation, use distributed counter for per-customer tracking, alert on threshold approach

failure_modes.name: Sanctions Screening False Negative
failure_modes.description: Customer or merchant is on sanctions list (FATF, OFAC, RBI) but screening lookup returns false due to name matching threshold too high, cache corruption, or lookup service failure.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Merchant 'Ahmed Khan Ltd' matches sanctions list entry 'Ahmed Khan' but name distance metric >0.85, screening passes
root_cause_patterns: fuzzy match threshold misconfigured
sanctions list update stale (>24h old)
whitelist override applied incorrectly
failure_modes.system_impact: Transacts with sanctioned entity, regulatory fine, license suspension risk
failure_modes.recovery_path: Regulatory audit or external notification triggers screening re-check; flag settlement for reversal, investigate prior transactions
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use conservative threshold (>0.95), update sanctions lists daily, verify merchant against multiple FATF lists, log all screening results

failure_modes.name: KYC Verification Bypass
failure_modes.description: Customer or merchant onboards without completing KYC (e.g., document upload skipped, verification pending). Orders placed and settled before KYC completes.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Merchant submits onboarding, gets temporary account ID, creates orders before KYC completion flag is checked in handler
root_cause_patterns: KYC status check missing from order creation handler
temporary account flag not enforced in payment workflow
KYC deadline extension not validated
failure_modes.system_impact: Unverified customer/merchant settles funds, regulatory breach, compliance investigation
failure_modes.recovery_path: Risk team detects unverified transactions in audit; place merchant account on hold, reverse recent settlements until KYC complete
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce KYC status check at order creation, payment initiation, and settlement phases; block orders for unverified accounts

failure_modes.name: Data Consent Missing (A2A/Data Sharing)
failure_modes.description: Order uses customer data (e.g., account linking, payment history) without explicit consent recorded in consent registry. Data sharing downstream without permission trail.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Payment settlement queries customer bank balance (via Account Aggregator) without consent.Verify() check
root_cause_patterns: consent check bypassed in settlement flow
consent record not created before data access
consent expiry not validated
failure_modes.system_impact: Regulatory violation (data privacy), customer complaint, potential fine for data misuse
failure_modes.recovery_path: Audit detects data access without consent; notify customer, obtain retroactive consent or reverse transaction
failure_modes.prevention_control: Record consent before any data access, validate consent expiry, audit all data access against consent log

failure_modes.name: Regulatory Reporting False Data
failure_modes.description: Settlement data aggregated for regulatory reporting (RBI, FATF) but includes errors: wrong amounts, missing transactions, duplicate entries. Filed report inaccurate.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Daily settlement report includes order that was reversed, causing reported turnover >actual; RBI notice
root_cause_patterns: reversed orders not excluded from report
amount rounding error in aggregation
report generation time window off-by-one
failure_modes.system_impact: Regulatory investigation, compliance penalty, audit dispute
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via RBI inquiry; file amended report, demonstrate correction in audit trail
failure_modes.prevention_control: Validate report data against settlement ledger, exclude reversed/cancelled orders, test reporting with known data set

failure_modes.name: Customer Risk Scoring Stale
failure_modes.description: Customer risk score used for compliance decision but cached score is outdated (e.g., recent PEP designation not reflected). Order approved for high-risk customer.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer was clean 24h ago; now designated PEP but cached score still 'low-risk', order approved
root_cause_patterns: risk score cache TTL too long (>24h)
no cache invalidation on external data update
PEP list update not triggering score recalculation
failure_modes.system_impact: High-risk customer transactions approved, regulatory oversight failure, potential sanctions evasion
failure_modes.recovery_path: Compliance audit detects stale risk score; recalculate for all orders by customer in past 24h, escalate high-risk ones
failure_modes.prevention_control: Reduce risk score cache TTL to 4h, subscribe to external PEP/sanctions updates, trigger immediate recalculation on alert

failure_modes.name: Compliance Decision Audit Trail Missing
failure_modes.description: Compliance check executed (AML, KYC, sanctions) but decision reason and evidence not recorded in audit trail. Later review cannot determine why order was approved/blocked.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order approved after velocity check but check parameters, thresholds, and cached results not logged
root_cause_patterns: compliance decision not logged to lineage
check parameters stripped before audit record
evidence (matching scores, list entries) not captured
failure_modes.system_impact: Cannot prove regulatory compliance, inspection failure, potential violation if decision was wrong
failure_modes.recovery_path: Enhance compliance logging; retroactively document decisions where possible from system state
failure_modes.prevention_control: Log compliance decision with full context: check type, thresholds, evidence, customer score, pass/fail, timestamp

failure_modes.name: Customer Document Verification Fraud
failure_modes.description: KYC document (PAN, Aadhaar) verified but fraudulent (deepfake, altered, reused from another customer). Merchant onboards with fake identity.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer uploads AI-generated PAN image; liveness check passes; account created with fake identity
root_cause_patterns: document verification using simple image comparison
no liveness check for identity docs
duplicate document check not enforced
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant account used for fraud, money laundering, regulatory breach
failure_modes.recovery_path: Fraud detection pattern identifies duplicate KYC docs; account quarantine, investigation, potential law enforcement
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use certified KYC providers (e-KYC via UIDAI), liveness checks, blockchain verification of documents, duplicate PAN screening

failure_modes.name: Invalid State Transition
failure_modes.description: Order workflow transitions from invalid state (e.g., Cancelled -> Fulfilled, or skips required step). State machine logic not enforced; order lineage shows impossible sequence.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order in StatusCancelled transitioned to StatusFulfilled, skipping payment step entirely
root_cause_patterns: no validation of current state before transition
external order status update not using state machine
concurrent state modification without lock
failure_modes.system_impact: Order lineage invalid, reconciliation detects impossible sequence, settlement integrity questioned
failure_modes.recovery_path: Lineage tracker detects invalid transition, flags order for manual review, rolls back to last valid state
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce state machine in DefaultWorkflowOrchestrator.ExecuteWorkflow(), use strict enum validation, log all transitions

failure_modes.name: Agent Communication Timeout
failure_modes.description: Payment Agent or Settlement Agent does not respond within timeout window. Workflow hangs waiting for confirmation, order stuck indefinitely.
failure_modes.example_scenario: PaymentAgentStub.InitiatePayment() blocks for >30s; workflow timeout not triggered, customer refund waits
root_cause_patterns: no timeout set on agent RPC call
synchronous agent call in critical path
agent service overloaded or crashed
failure_modes.system_impact: Order processing stalled, customer refund delay, potential refund timeout trigger, settlement missed
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitor workflow timeout; escalate to agent health check, trigger automatic retry with circuit breaker, HITL escalation
failure_modes.prevention_control: Set explicit timeout on agent calls (e.g., 30s), implement automatic retry logic, use async patterns (task queue)

failure_modes.name: Workflow Step Out-of-Order Execution
failure_modes.description: Workflow steps executed in wrong order (e.g., settlement initiated before payment confirmed, fulfillment before settlement). Order state corrupted.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement initiated while payment still pending; settlement fails because payment not confirmed in ledger
root_cause_patterns: no dependency check between workflow steps
concurrent step execution without blocking
retry logic re-executing in wrong order
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement fails due to invalid preconditions, order requires manual intervention, audit trail shows bad sequence
failure_modes.recovery_path: Lineage tracker detects out-of-order steps; rewind to last valid checkpoint and re-execute in correct order
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce strict step sequencing in ExecuteWorkflow(), block step execution until prior step completes, log step entry/exit

failure_modes.name: Duplicate Payment Agent Call
failure_modes.description: Payment agent call initiated twice for same order (e.g., retry logic re-triggers before first response received). Customer charged twice.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Retry timer fires while first payment still pending; second InitiatePayment() called with same orderID
root_cause_patterns: no idempotency key on payment request
retry logic triggered before first attempt completes
agent response cache not checked before retry
failure_modes.system_impact: Customer charged twice, merchant receives double settlement, complaint and chargeback
failure_modes.recovery_path: Reconciliation detects duplicate settlement; identify duplicate, issue reversal to customer, adjust merchant balance
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement idempotency key (orderID) on payment request, check payment status before retrying, use deduplication cache

failure_modes.name: Orchestrator Crash During Workflow
failure_modes.description: Orchestrator process crashes mid-workflow (e.g., during settlement). Order state not persisted; on restart, unclear if settlement completed or rolled back.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Orchestrator initiates settlement, ledger confirms, but orchestrator crashes before lineage.Record() and order status update
root_cause_patterns: workflow state not persisted to durable store
no recovery checkpoint on orchestrator start
two-phase commit not used
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement state ambiguous, order-ledger mismatch on restart, requires manual reconciliation
failure_modes.recovery_path: On restart, query ledger for settlement confirmation; if found, complete order status update; if not, rollback and refund
failure_modes.prevention_control: Persist workflow state before each critical step, implement recovery handler on startup, use two-phase commit

failure_modes.name: Race Condition in Workflow Lock
failure_modes.description: Two concurrent workflows attempt to process same order simultaneously (e.g., webhook callback + polling). Both proceed as if they have exclusive lock; state corrupted.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Payment webhook callback and polling timer both fire; both call ExecuteWorkflow(orderID), both update state without mutual exclusion
root_cause_patterns: no mutex lock in ExecuteWorkflow()
distributed lock (e.g., Redis) not implemented
webhook + polling race window
failure_modes.system_impact: Order state corrupted, settlement applied twice or conflicted, audit trail shows race damage
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via reconciliation mismatch; manually inspect state, undo corrupted transitions, replay in correct order
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use mutex lock (o.mu) in ExecuteWorkflow(), implement distributed lock for multi-instance scenarios, use optimistic locking

failure_modes.name: Missing Error Handler in Workflow
failure_modes.description: Workflow encounters error (payment declined, settlement timeout) but error is ignored or not propagated. Order proceeds as if success.
failure_modes.example_scenario: PaymentAgentStub returns error; ExecuteWorkflow doesn't check error, assumes success, initiates settlement anyway
root_cause_patterns: missing error check on agent response
_ = ignoring error in handler
error swallowed in goroutine without propagation
failure_modes.system_impact: Order proceeds without payment/settlement, customer not charged, revenue lost, settlement mismatch
failure_modes.recovery_path: Audit finds settlement without payment confirmation, flag order for reversal and refund
failure_modes.prevention_control: Check all error returns, log errors with context, propagate errors to caller, use structured error types

failure_modes.name: Workflow Rollback Incomplete
failure_modes.description: Payment succeeds but settlement fails. Rollback initiated but only partially completes (e.g., ledger reversal succeeds but order status not rolled back). Inconsistent state.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement fails; ledger refund issued but order status not reset to StatusPaid; audit shows inconsistency
root_cause_patterns: rollback logic not transactional
rollback itself fails without cascading undo
missing compensating transaction
failure_modes.system_impact: Order state inconsistent with ledger, reconciliation fails, manual HITL required to resolve
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via reconciliation.IsReconciled(); apply compensating transaction to match order and ledger state
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement transactional rollback with all-or-nothing semantics, log rollback steps, verify rollback success

failure_modes.name: Merchant Account Impersonation
failure_modes.description: Third party registers merchant account using stolen merchant identity documents or name spoofing. Fraudster settles orders and withdraws funds.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Attacker uploads merchant PAN/GSTIN belonging to legitimate business; account approved, orders settled to fraudster bank account
root_cause_patterns: weak merchant document verification
no business registration validation
bank account ownership not confirmed
failure_modes.system_impact: Fraudster controls merchant account, legitimate merchant loses reputation, regulatory investigation
failure_modes.recovery_path: Merchant reports fraud; suspend account, quarantine settlements, file police report, identify and block attacker
failure_modes.prevention_control: Verify merchant identity with government registries (GST, MCA), confirm bank account ownership via micro-deposit, use certified KYUA

failure_modes.name: Customer Card Number Reuse (Multiple Accounts)
failure_modes.description: Same card linked to multiple customer accounts, allowing fraud (e.g., velocity bypass, chargebacks). Account linking rule not enforced.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Card ending in 1234 linked to Customer A and Customer B; both exceed velocity limits in aggregate but checked independently
root_cause_patterns: duplicate card check only per customer
no aggregate velocity across linked accounts
card linkage table not consulted
failure_modes.system_impact: Fraud activity across multiple accounts, velocity bypass, chargebacks, customer account takeover
failure_modes.recovery_path: Fraud detection identifies card reuse; freeze linked accounts, investigate transaction pattern, contact legitimate account holders
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement card-to-account graph, check all transactions by all accounts linked to card, enforce shared velocity limits

failure_modes.name: Merchant Dispute Not Routed (Lost)
failure_modes.description: Customer disputes charge or merchant initiates refund dispute. Dispute message not routed to dispute agent or loses message in queue. Dispute never resolved.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer raises dispute in UI; message queued but never picked up by dispute agent due to queue crash
root_cause_patterns: message queue failure
dispute handler crashed
no retry/dead-letter queue for unprocessed disputes
failure_modes.system_impact: Dispute unresolved, customer chargeback filed, settlement reversed after grace period, merchant loses confidence
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitoring detects unprocessed disputes; replay from queue, manually route to dispute agent, contact parties
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use reliable message queue with persistence, implement dispute handler with retry logic, monitor queue depth and latency

failure_modes.name: Merchant Settlement Withdraw to Wrong Account
failure_modes.description: Merchant initiates settlement withdrawal but funds transferred to wrong account (e.g., incorrect IFSC, account number not validated). Merchant loses funds to third party.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Merchant submits settlement withdraw with typo in account number; funds sent to random account, non-recoverable
root_cause_patterns: no IFSC/account validation before transfer
account name mismatch not checked
no confirmation step for withdraw request
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant funds lost, regulatory complaint, potential liability claim against platform
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via merchant complaint; attempt to recover from beneficiary bank, if unsuccessful, file incident, may require loss absorption
failure_modes.prevention_control: Validate IFSC/account combination via NEFT registry, verify account name matches merchant, require OTP/2FA confirmation, trial transfer

failure_modes.name: Customer Refund Never Issued
failure_modes.description: Order cancelled or payment declined but refund not processed (e.g., refund workflow not triggered, refund agent down). Customer balance not credited.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order payment fails; refund initiated but refund agent timeout; settlement shows debit but no credit, customer account stuck
root_cause_patterns: refund not triggered on payment failure
refund agent unavailable
no timeout/retry on refund request
failure_modes.system_impact: Customer funds trapped, complaint escalation, potential fine for delayed refund (RBI max 7 days)
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitor refund SLA; detect unrefunded orders >7 days old, issue manual refund, investigate root cause
failure_modes.prevention_control: Trigger refund automatically on payment failure, implement refund timeout SLA (e.g., 24h), alert on overdue refunds

failure_modes.name: Chargeback Not Recorded in Lineage
failure_modes.description: Customer issues chargeback (card network/bank reversal). Chargeback processed by bank but not recorded in lineage or reflected in settlement reconciliation.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer card chargeback processed by bank; settlement shows merchant received funds but chargeback not in audit trail
root_cause_patterns: no integration with card networks for chargeback notification
chargeback notification received but not logged
settlement not adjusted for chargeback
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement appears final but merchant may owe funds due to chargeback; unreconciled discrepancy
failure_modes.recovery_path: Bank or card network notifies platform of chargeback; create lineage entry, reverse settlement, adjust merchant balance
failure_modes.prevention_control: Subscribe to card network chargeback notifications, log all chargebacks to lineage, adjust settlement in real-time, monitor for net reversals

failure_modes.name: Merchant Commission Calculation Error
failure_modes.description: Platform commission/fees calculated incorrectly for merchant settlement (e.g., percentage applied to wrong amount, rounding error). Merchant receives more/less than owed.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Merchant settlement of ₹10,000 with 2% commission; commission calculated as ₹200 on ₹10k instead of ₹100 on ₹5k referral
root_cause_patterns: commission percentage applied to gross instead of net
rounding to nearest rupee instead of paise
commission formula not validated
failure_modes.system_impact: Merchant payment incorrect, platform loses or gains money, audit discrepancy, merchant complaint
failure_modes.recovery_path: Audit detects calculation error; issue adjustment/credit to merchant, correct future calculations
failure_modes.prevention_control: Validate commission calculation against documented formula, test with known amounts, log commission details in lineage

failure_modes.name: Customer Account Lockout Due to Failed Verification
failure_modes.description: Customer permanently locked out of account due to failed verification (e.g., KYC re-verification, 2FA threshold). No recovery path or escalation.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer fails KYC re-verification 3x; account auto-locked with no appeal process, cannot order or access funds
root_cause_patterns: no account unlock path after threshold
no HITL escalation for legitimate users
no customer support override mechanism
failure_modes.system_impact: Customer unable to use platform, trapped funds, customer churn, regulatory complaint
failure_modes.recovery_path: Customer support escalation; verify customer identity through alternative means, unlock account, investigate false positive
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement account lockout with manual unlock, escalate to HITL after 2 failures, provide customer appeal process

failure_modes.name: Agent Hallucination in Settlement Amount
failure_modes.description: LLM agent in settlement flow generates/hallucinates incorrect amount or transaction ID that doesn't exist in ledger. Amount used for settlement is wrong.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement agent queries order amount, LLM generates '₹50,000 paise' (should be '500 paise'); amount used in settlement
root_cause_patterns: LLM not grounded in deterministic order lookup
amount not verified against order before settlement
no constraint checking on generated amount
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement amount wrong, merchant overpaid or underpaid, financial loss, regulatory concern
failure_modes.recovery_path: Reconciliation detects amount mismatch; identify hallucinated vs. actual amount, issue adjustment
failure_modes.prevention_control: Agent must fetch order from database, not generate; validate amount against ledger before settling, use tool-use for amount retrieval

failure_modes.name: Agent Prompt Injection (SQL/Command)
failure_modes.description: Attacker crafts malicious order or user input that injects SQL/system command into agent prompt. Agent executes unintended command (e.g., deletes orders, transfers funds).
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order description contains ''; DROP TABLE orders; --' ; agent parses and executes, deleting order history
root_cause_patterns: user input concatenated into agent prompt without sanitization
agent has direct database/CLI access
no prompt validation or constraint enforcement
failure_modes.system_impact: Data loss, unauthorized transactions, system compromise, regulatory breach
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via audit log of unexpected operations; restore from backup, investigate attacker, secure system
failure_modes.prevention_control: Never concatenate user input into prompts, use parameterized agent instructions, sandbox agent execution, validate tool inputs

failure_modes.name: Agent Consistency Drift (Cross-Turn)
failure_modes.description: Multi-turn agent conversation where agent's facts or decisions change between turns (e.g., customer risk score evaluated as 'low' in turn 1 but 'high' in turn 2, same customer). Inconsistent settlement decision.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement agent evaluates customer risk in turn 1 ('low-risk, approved'), turn 2 same customer ('high-risk, block')
root_cause_patterns: context not persisted between turns
LLM temperature too high (non-deterministic)
grounding data changed between turns without notification
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement decisions inconsistent, audit trail shows contradictory assessments, regulatory concern
failure_modes.recovery_path: Audit detects inconsistency; use earlier (more conservative) decision, flag for manual review
failure_modes.prevention_control: Persist context across turns, use temperature=0 for deterministic responses, log grounding data snapshot per turn

failure_modes.name: Agent Tool Misuse (Wrong Agent for Task)
failure_modes.description: Agent selects wrong tool/subagent for task (e.g., settlement agent uses fraud-detection agent instead of compliance check). Tool returns irrelevant data, decision made on bad info.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement agent tries to verify merchant identity using fraud-detection tool (wrong tool); gets fraud score instead of KYC status
root_cause_patterns: agent tool description unclear or overlapping
agent confused about which tool solves which problem
tool registry not organized by domain
failure_modes.system_impact: Wrong information used for settlement decision, potential compliance violation, inefficient process
failure_modes.recovery_path: Audit detects wrong tool usage; re-evaluate decision with correct tool, correct if needed
failure_modes.prevention_control: Define clear tool descriptions with examples, use tool selection validation, test agent tool chains

failure_modes.name: Agent Refusal Without Clear Reason
failure_modes.description: Agent refuses to process legitimate order (e.g., settlement agent refusal to settle valid batch) without clear error explanation. Order stuck.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement agent receives valid batch but LLM interprets batch amount as 'suspicious' and refuses without logging reason
root_cause_patterns: LLM refusal due to misaligned safety guardrails
refusal reason not logged
no override mechanism for legitimate but unusual cases
failure_modes.system_impact: Legitimate settlement blocked, merchants unpaid, settlement SLA breached
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitoring detects refusal; add context to agent prompt or override with HITL approval, escalate to model tuning
failure_modes.prevention_control: Log all agent refusals with reason, tune agent guardrails to avoid false positives, implement HITL override for refusals

failure_modes.name: Agent Alignment Drift (Value Misalignment)
failure_modes.description: Agent's decision-making drifts from intended business logic (e.g., agent prioritizes speed over compliance, approves high-risk transactions). Agent behavior misaligned with RBI guidelines.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Compliance agent increasingly approves high-risk customers to meet settlement SLA targets, ignoring AML rules
root_cause_patterns: agent fine-tuned on incorrect reward signal
prompt instructions prioritize speed over compliance
no alignment monitoring or auditing
failure_modes.system_impact: Regulatory violations, money laundering, customer sanction evasion, license risk
failure_modes.recovery_path: Compliance audit detects drift; retrain agent on correct objectives, re-evaluate past decisions
failure_modes.prevention_control: Define explicit agent objectives aligned with RBI guidelines, monitor agent decisions against policy, regular alignment audits

failure_modes.name: Lineage Hash Chain Broken
failure_modes.description: Settlement lineage recorded but hash chain integrity broken (e.g., entry modified or deleted, hash not re-computed). Audit trail no longer cryptographically verifiable.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Lineage entry for settlement modified (amount changed); hash not updated; verification returns false
root_cause_patterns: lineage entry updated without hash re-computation
hash chain not verified on read
no permission control on lineage modification
failure_modes.system_impact: Audit trail invalid, regulatory inspection failure, cannot prove transaction occurred as recorded
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via lineage.Verify(ctx) returning broken chain; restore from backup, investigate unauthorized modification
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce immutable lineage writes, verify hash chain on every read, use cryptographic signatures, restrict lineage modification permissions

failure_modes.name: Audit Entry Missing Required Fields
failure_modes.description: Settlement audit entry created but missing critical fields (e.g., no amount, no timestamp, no error code). Later audit cannot reconstruct what happened.
failure_modes.example_scenario: AuditEntry for settlement has ID and OrderID but no Input/Output amounts; cannot verify settlement correctness
root_cause_patterns: audit logging code skips optional fields
no schema validation on audit entry
error case logging not complete
failure_modes.system_impact: Audit trail incomplete, cannot prove settlement correctness, regulatory audit incomplete
failure_modes.recovery_path: Reconstruct missing fields from order/ledger history if possible; otherwise flag for manual review
failure_modes.prevention_control: Enforce required fields in AuditEntry struct, validate on write, log comprehensive context (amount, parties, status, error)

failure_modes.name: Lineage Timestamp Manipulation
failure_modes.description: Audit entry timestamp modified (e.g., backdated to hide late settlement or make transaction appear earlier). Regulatory timeline audit manipulated.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement completed at 17:00 but lineage entry backdated to 09:00 to appear within settlement SLA
root_cause_patterns: system clock skew or manual clock adjustment
lineage entry timestamp not server-generated
no audit of timestamp modifications
failure_modes.system_impact: Settlement SLA audit invalid, regulatory timeline untrustworthy, compliance audit failure
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via cross-check with blockchain/external ledger timestamp; correct timeline, investigate manipulation
failure_modes.prevention_control: Generate timestamp server-side using atomic clock, make timestamp immutable after creation, audit timestamp changes

failure_modes.name: Settlement Order-Ledger-Lineage Mismatch
failure_modes.description: Order, ledger, and lineage records show contradictory information about settlement (e.g., order shows fulfilled, ledger shows pending, lineage shows cancelled). Impossible to trust any record.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Order StatusFulfilled, but lineage shows StepSettlementFailed, ledger shows ledger.Pending; reconciliation fails
root_cause_patterns: order status and ledger not updated atomically
lineage entry not created synchronously with ledger
rollback logic not coordinated across systems
failure_modes.system_impact: Cannot determine true settlement state, regulatory audit impossible, settlement integrity questioned
failure_modes.recovery_path: Query all three sources (order, ledger, lineage); use lineage as source of truth, correct order/ledger to match
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use two-phase commit to atomically update order+ledger+lineage, implement reconciliation.IsReconciled() check, log all updates

failure_modes.name: Lineage Query Response Tampering
failure_modes.description: Attacker intercepts lineage query response and modifies data (e.g., changes settlement amount) before returning to auditor. Auditor sees false settlement record.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Auditor queries lineage for settlement; attacker MITM intercepts and changes amount from 500 to 5000 paise
root_cause_patterns: lineage API response not signed
no TLS/encryption on lineage queries
audit queries over unencrypted channel
failure_modes.system_impact: Audit trail forged, regulatory audit untrustworthy, settlement history falsified
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via signature verification failure; query backup ledger, compare hashes, identify tampering point
failure_modes.prevention_control: Sign lineage responses with immutable keys, enforce TLS on all lineage queries, validate signatures on read

failure_modes.name: Lineage Record Deletion (Regulatory Erasure)
failure_modes.description: Lineage records deleted (legitimately for GDPR or fraudulently) but deletion not tracked. Later audit cannot determine what was deleted or why.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer requests GDPR erasure; settlement lineage deleted but no deletion log entry; auditor cannot see deletion occurred
root_cause_patterns: deletion not logged to audit trail
no soft-delete mechanism (logical instead of physical)
deletion reason not recorded
failure_modes.system_impact: Cannot audit data deletions, regulatory privacy compliance unverifiable, potential litigation risk
failure_modes.recovery_path: Implement immutable deletion log; query log to see what was deleted and when
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use soft deletes (logical deletion with timestamp), log all deletions with reason and approver, implement deletion audit trail

failure_modes.name: Settlement Round-Trip Verification Failure
failure_modes.description: Settlement amount committed to ledger but round-trip verification (ledger re-query) shows different balance. Ledger corruption or concurrency bug.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement commits ₹500, ledger confirms, but immediate query shows balance unchanged; double-check fails
root_cause_patterns: ledger write not synchronized with read
read-your-own-write not guaranteed
replication lag in distributed ledger
failure_modes.system_impact: Ledger state untrustworthy, settlement might not have actually occurred, reconciliation broken
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via round-trip verification; query backup ledger, enforce consistency, retry transaction
failure_modes.prevention_control: Use strongly consistent ledger with ACID guarantees, implement read-your-own-write check, test consistency properties

failure_modes.name: Compliance Rule Change Mid-Transaction
failure_modes.description: Compliance rule updated during transaction processing (e.g., velocity limit lowered). Transaction started under old rule but completed under new rule. Inconsistent application.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Velocity limit lowered from ₹100k to ₹50k mid-settlement; order approved under old rule but rejected under new rule mid-way
root_cause_patterns: no rule snapshot at transaction start
rule change not versioned
no enforcement of rule version consistency
failure_modes.system_impact: Rule application inconsistent, some transactions allowed under old rules, potential compliance violation
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via audit review; re-evaluate order under new rules, escalate if impact
failure_modes.prevention_control: Snapshot compliance rules at transaction start, use rule version in audit entry, enforce version consistency

failure_modes.name: Workflow Deadlock (Circular Dependency)
failure_modes.description: Workflow enters deadlock where multiple steps wait for each other (e.g., settlement waits for payment confirmation but payment status check waits for settlement to start). Workflow hangs permanently.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement step waits for PaymentConfirmed, but payment polling waits for settlement initiation; neither proceeds
root_cause_patterns: circular dependency in step prerequisites
no timeout to break deadlock
no deadlock detection algorithm
failure_modes.system_impact: Workflow hangs indefinitely, orders not processed, settlement SLA breached
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitor timeout detects hang; forcefully advance one step, break deadlock, continue workflow
failure_modes.prevention_control: Design workflow as DAG (no cycles), implement deadlock timeout, use fallback/skip logic for optional dependencies

failure_modes.name: Customer KYC Expiry Not Enforced
failure_modes.description: Customer KYC verification expired (e.g., 1 year old per RBI rules) but not re-verified. Customer continues to transact with expired KYC. Settlement proceeds.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Customer KYC verified 13 months ago; RBI requires re-verification annually; but order settled without KYC renewal check
root_cause_patterns: KYC expiry date not checked before order
no trigger for KYC renewal workflow
KYC status not marked expired
failure_modes.system_impact: Regulatory violation (stale KYC), customer identity unverified for recent transaction, compliance breach
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via KYC expiry audit; flag customer for re-verification, hold settlements until renewed, notify customer
failure_modes.prevention_control: Check KYC expiry before order/settlement, trigger re-verification workflow at 11-month mark, block orders for expired KYC

failure_modes.name: Agent Context Window Overflow
failure_modes.description: Agent prompt + context exceeds model context window limit. Agent response truncated or error returned. Decision based on incomplete information.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement agent with 500k token history of order details; context window 4k tokens; settlement metadata dropped
root_cause_patterns: context history not truncated
no context pruning strategy
large order details in context without summarization
failure_modes.system_impact: Decision made on incomplete history, potential duplicate or wrong settlement decision
failure_modes.recovery_path: Detect via model error; re-query with summarized context, or escalate to deterministic path
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement context pruning (keep recent N turns), summarize old context, use smaller context window models for high-volume tasks

failure_modes.name: Lineage Privacy Data Leakage
failure_modes.description: Sensitive lineage data (customer name, account number, card details) logged in audit entry without encryption. Data accessible to unauthorized parties via audit API.
failure_modes.example_scenario: AuditEntry.Input contains full customer SSN and card details; auditor API accessible by app staff, data exposed
root_cause_patterns: lineage entries not encrypted
PII not redacted from audit logs
audit API not access-controlled
failure_modes.system_impact: Privacy breach, customer data leak, regulatory fine, liability
failure_modes.recovery_path: Encrypt or redact sensitive fields in lineage, restrict audit access, notify affected customers
failure_modes.prevention_control: Encrypt lineage at rest, redact PII from audit entries (log only last 4 digits), enforce RBAC on audit API, encrypt in transit

failure_modes.name: Settlement Retry Loop Infinite
failure_modes.description: Settlement fails and retry logic loops infinitely without exponential backoff or max retry limit. Resource exhaustion and log overflow.
failure_modes.example_scenario: Settlement timeout triggers retry; retry also times out; no max retry check; loop continues consuming resources
root_cause_patterns: no max retry counter
no exponential backoff
retry triggered for permanent errors (not transient)
failure_modes.system_impact: Resource exhaustion, log storage overflow, system slow-down, other orders blocked
failure_modes.recovery_path: Monitor retry loop; kill retry loop, escalate to HITL, fix underlying settlement cause
failure_modes.prevention_control: Implement max retries (e.g., 3), exponential backoff, classify errors (transient vs. permanent), only retry transient
